title: 390th Memorial Museum Personnel & Mission database - Mission 023, Schweinfurt GE, 10/14/1943 (164 crew-sortie records: name, position, fate, aircraft tail number, aircraft name, model, crew number)
notes: Browse Missions > page 3 > 023 Schweinfurt GE. Compiled by the museum from 390th records. Tail numbers given without hyphen and with leading fiscal-year digit (e.g. 230338 = 42-30338, 23327 = 42-3327).

title: Mission 023 Schweinfurt GE synopsis (390th Memorial Museum mission record)
notes: Cites 390th Mission Report No. 23 (Mission Reports Part I, file no. 987-988), "390th Bomb Group: History of Aircraft Assigned" (unpublished MS), The Story of the 390th Bombardment Group (1947), Rydell "Louis Dolan: Letters Home". States 18 ordered, 4 aborted, 3 100th BG aircraft attached, target VKF Werke II, over target ~1455, landed ~1815, loss of 42-29991.

title: B-17 42-29991 "Patches" (aka "We'll Never Know")
notes: Block B-17F-80-BO, 571st BS code FC-T, MACR 858, crash site, Luftwaffe claim, crew with ranks, summaries of MACR 858 eyewitness statements (Asmussen, Brown, Dolan, Jeffrey, Clark, Cartwright, Geary, Riley).
